init.title: Power Management
init.description: Choose which optional segments to enable below. Solar PV Plant itself is always included.

data_description.ev_charging: Manage EV charger scheduling and load control, e.g. charging on solar surplus or off-peak spot prices.
data_description.pool: Manage pool pump/heater scheduling, e.g. running the pump during solar surplus hours.
data_description.pv_surplus: Manage what happens to solar production left over once the battery and other loads are covered.

pv_inverter.title: Solar PV Plant
pv_inverter.description: Which inverter do you have? Picking one lets PwMngt auto-fill several of the next page's fields for you.

solar_pv_plant.title: Solar PV Plant
solar_pv_plant.description: Pick the entity in your own Home Assistant that PwMngt should mirror for each value below.{auto_filled_note}{derived_fields_note}
solar_pv_plant.derived_fields_note: ⚙️ **Growatt Modbus: leave these fields empty -- PwMngt calculates them itself:**

data_description.battery_soc: The entity that reports your home battery's state of charge (%), e.g. your inverter's battery SoC sensor. Only "%"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.battery_pv_charged: Growatt Modbus: leave empty -- PwMngt calculates it (Battery Charge Total minus AC Charge Energy Total). Otherwise: the entity that reports total energy charged into the battery (kWh) from your solar plant, e.g. from your inverter. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.battery_pv_discharged: The entity that reports total energy discharged from the battery (kWh). Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.battery_power: The entity that reports the battery's current charge/discharge power (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.invert_battery_power: Tick if the battery power entity reports charging as positive. PwMngt expects positive = discharging. Ticked automatically for Growatt Modbus.
data_description.battery_grid_charged_day: The entity that reports how much energy has been charged into the battery from the grid today (kWh) -- a daily counter that resets at midnight, e.g. your inverter's own "charge from grid today" sensor. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. Pre-filled automatically from your inverter if it's a supported brand. Used to tell grid-charged battery content from PV-charged.

data_description.pv1_power: The entity that reports PV string 1's current power output (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.pv2_power: The entity that reports PV string 2's current power output (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed. Optional -- leave empty if you don't have a second PV string.
data_description.pv3_power: The entity that reports PV string 3's current power output (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed. Optional -- leave empty if you don't have a third PV string.

data_description.grid_power: The entity that reports current power flow to/from the grid (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.invert_grid_power: Tick if the grid power entity reports export as positive. PwMngt expects positive = buying from the grid.
data_description.pv_direct_consumption: Growatt Modbus: leave empty -- PwMngt calculates it from House Consumption, PV, grid import and battery discharge. Otherwise: the entity that reports power currently consumed directly from PV production (W), without going through the battery. Only "W"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.pv_total_consumption: Growatt Modbus: leave empty -- PwMngt sums PV direct consumption over time. Otherwise: the entity that reports total cumulative PV consumption (kWh). Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.property_consumption_total: The house's own cumulative consumption (kWh) -- WITHOUT the battery's charging, from the grid or PV. A counter that includes battery charging makes the night consumption, and so Battery nightly target, too high: the battery is then charged more every night. Use your inverter's own house consumption counter -- pre-filled automatically for supported brands. Must be a raw, ever-increasing lifetime counter, not a Daily Utility Meter helper (PwMngt tracks the local-midnight reset itself). Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed.

data_description.pv_forecast_today: The entity that reports today's forecasted PV production for the whole plant (kWh), e.g. from a solar forecast integration. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. Pre-filled automatically if Solcast PV Forecast is installed and unambiguous -- pick a different entity if you don't want that.
data_description.pv_forecast_tomorrow: The entity that reports tomorrow's forecasted PV production for the whole plant (kWh), e.g. from a solar forecast integration. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. Pre-filled automatically if Solcast PV Forecast is installed and unambiguous -- pick a different entity if you don't want that.

data_description.spot_electricity_price: The entity that reports your current total electricity price including VAT/tariffs (kr/kWh) -- not the raw spot price -- e.g. Strømligning's own VAT-inclusive price sensor. Only "kr/kWh"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.electricity_price_surcharge: A fixed amount (kr/kWh, incl. VAT) your supplier adds on top of the price above, if your configured price entity doesn't already include it -- e.g. a flat per-kWh markup. Added to that price everywhere PwMngt calculates money from it. Leave at 0 if your price entity already reflects what you actually pay.

data_description.main_fuse_load_l1: The entity that reports the current load (A) on phase L1 of the property's main fuse. Only "A"-unit sensors are listed. Optional -- leave empty ("Not available") if you don't have a phase-current meter; the value is then treated as 0.
data_description.main_fuse_load_l2: The entity that reports the current load (A) on phase L2 of the property's main fuse. Only "A"-unit sensors are listed. Optional -- leave empty ("Not available") if you don't have a phase-current meter; the value is then treated as 0.
data_description.main_fuse_load_l3: The entity that reports the current load (A) on phase L3 of the property's main fuse. Only "A"-unit sensors are listed. Optional -- leave empty ("Not available") if you don't have a phase-current meter; the value is then treated as 0.

data_description.sell_force_override: An input_boolean, switch, or binary_sensor your own automations can turn on to force the battery into selling mode right now, regardless of what PwMngt's own price/forecast calculation would otherwise decide. One-way only -- it can only force selling, never prevent it. Optional -- leave empty ("Not available") if you don't have an automation like this; the sell decision then runs purely on its own calculation.

data_description.electricity_tax_full_rate: Your own sensor reporting the current full electricity-tax rate (kr/kWh, incl. VAT), e.g. Strømligning's tax sensor. Used to calculate the fictional "purchase price without PV" (what you'd pay if 100% of your consumption had to be bought from the grid) and the savings sensors below, together with the PwM hub's "Billing period" and "Electricity tax" selects on the Configuration tab, which decide the tax threshold and whether the reduced rate applies at all. Optional -- leave empty ("Not available") if you don't track this; those sensors then stay unavailable.
data_description.household_consumption_hourly: The entity that reports your household's total consumption (kWh) as a raw, ever-increasing lifetime counter, not a Daily/Hourly Utility Meter helper -- PwMngt derives each hour's own figure itself, and tolerates the counter resetting or you repointing this field at a new entity later (e.g. after replacing an inverter). Optional -- leave empty if you don't have one.
data_description.grid_import_hourly: The entity that reports electricity imported from the grid (kWh) as a raw, ever-increasing lifetime counter -- same reasoning as the field above. Not a net counter (export minus import), which can also go down. Optional -- leave empty if you don't have one.
data_description.battery_grid_charge_hourly: The entity that reports energy charged into the battery from the grid specifically (kWh) as a raw, ever-increasing lifetime counter -- same reasoning as the field above. Optional -- leave empty if you don't have one.
data_description.battery_discharge_hourly: The entity that reports all energy the battery discharged (kWh) as a raw, ever-increasing lifetime counter -- including any sold to the grid. Same reasoning as the field above. Optional -- leave empty if you don't have one.

data_description.seed_purchase_price_real: If you're migrating from an existing Node-RED setup tracking this same running total (kr), point this at that old sensor so PwMngt's own total starts from its current value instead of 0. Used once: the next time PwMngt starts, it raises its own total up to this sensor's current value (never lowers it) and then clears this field, so it can't be applied again by mistake. Pick the sensor again to carry it over once more. Leave empty ("Not available") on a fresh install with no history to carry over. "Own production savings" is then derived automatically from this and the field below, instead of needing its own seed.
data_description.seed_purchase_price_real_without_pv: Same idea as above, for the "purchase price without PV (real)" running total.
data_description.seed_battery_grid_charge_sum: Same idea as above, for the "battery charged from grid" running total. "Battery charging savings" is then derived automatically from this and the field below, instead of needing its own seed.
data_description.seed_battery_grid_discharge_sum: Same idea as above, for the "battery discharged from grid" running total.

kostal_control.name: Kostal control (optional)

data_description.kostal_min_soc: The Kostal's "Battery min SoC" number. PwMngt writes Battery data's min SoC to it while "Inverter control" on PwM PV is on.
data_description.kostal_usage_mode: The Kostal's "Battery Charging / Usage mode" select. "Block charging" sets it to Battery:TimeControl:Enable, everything else to None.
data_description.kostal_relay_1: The relay on the inverter's digital input 1. Charge and discharge set the relays in combinations (charge 25/50/75/100 %: 1-3 / 1-2-3 / 1-4 / 1-2, discharge: 3 / 2-3 / 4 / 2) -- the inverter's table for the digital inputs must match. All four must be filled in, or the relays aren't used.
data_description.kostal_relay_2: The relay on the inverter's digital input 2. Charge and discharge set the relays in combinations (charge 25/50/75/100 %: 1-3 / 1-2-3 / 1-4 / 1-2, discharge: 3 / 2-3 / 4 / 2) -- the inverter's table for the digital inputs must match. All four must be filled in, or the relays aren't used.
data_description.kostal_relay_3: The relay on the inverter's digital input 3. Charge and discharge set the relays in combinations (charge 25/50/75/100 %: 1-3 / 1-2-3 / 1-4 / 1-2, discharge: 3 / 2-3 / 4 / 2) -- the inverter's table for the digital inputs must match. All four must be filled in, or the relays aren't used.
data_description.kostal_relay_4: The relay on the inverter's digital input 4. Charge and discharge set the relays in combinations (charge 25/50/75/100 %: 1-3 / 1-2-3 / 1-4 / 1-2, discharge: 3 / 2-3 / 4 / 2) -- the inverter's table for the digital inputs must match. All four must be filled in, or the relays aren't used.

kostal_control.description: Only used while the switch **Inverter control** on PwM PV is on -- it is off by default, so PwMngt writes nothing to the inverter until you turn it on.

ev_charging.title: EV Charging
ev_charging.description: Pick each charger's type and, if installed, its physical device.

ev_charging_consumption.title: EV Charging
ev_charging_consumption.description: Pick each charger's own added-energy sensor (e.g. Wallbox's "Added energy" or Easee's "Session Energy"). For type "Other": the energy sensor of the meter on the charger's supply (e.g. a Shelly) -- PwMngt uses the power sensor on the same device to see when the car charges.{auto_filled_note}

error.required_in_section: One or more required fields above are still empty.
error.duplicate_charger_device: This device is already selected for another charger.

missing_solcast_solar.title: Solcast PV Forecast is not installed
missing_solcast_solar.description:
PwMngt's "PV forecast today" and "PV forecast tomorrow" fields (Options -> Solar PV Plant) expect a whole-plant solar forecast sensor (kWh), which normally comes from the **Solcast PV Forecast** integration. Without it there's nothing to pick for those two required fields, and the Solar PV Plant wizard can't be completed.

Install and set up Solcast PV Forecast (via HACS, or search for it directly in Settings -> Devices & services -> Add integration), then revisit PwMngt's options to pick its forecast sensor. This warning clears itself automatically once Solcast PV Forecast is installed.

missing_stromligning.title: Strømligning is not installed
missing_stromligning.description:
PwMngt's "Spot electricity price" field (Options -> Solar PV Plant) expects a spot-price sensor (kr/kWh), which normally comes from the **Strømligning** integration. Without it there's nothing to pick for this required field, and the Solar PV Plant wizard can't be completed.

Install and set up Strømligning (via HACS, or search for it directly in Settings -> Devices & services -> Add integration), then revisit PwMngt's options to pick its price sensor. This warning clears itself automatically once Strømligning is installed.

charge_not_responding.title: The battery doesn't respond to the charge command
charge_not_responding.description:
PwMngt asked the battery to charge, but it showed no charge power -- also after the command was sent again 3 times (2 minutes on "internal" in between).

Check the inverter (its own event log and battery status) and whatever passes the battery command on to it (relays, Node-RED). This warning clears itself the next time a charge works.

field_missing.title: PwMngt: the sensor for "{field}" is missing
field_missing.description:
PwMngt's field **{field}** points at `{entity_id}`, which doesn't exist (or is disabled). PwMngt calculates without it, so the numbers that depend on it are wrong or stand still.

Pick another sensor in PwMngt's options (Settings -> Devices & services -> PwMngt -> Configure), or enable the entity again. This warning clears itself once the field works.

field_unavailable.title: PwMngt: the sensor for "{field}" has been unavailable for 12 hours
field_unavailable.description:
PwMngt's field **{field}** points at `{entity_id}`, which has been unavailable for at least 12 hours. PwMngt calculates without it, so the numbers that depend on it are wrong or stand still.

Check the integration behind the sensor, or pick another sensor in PwMngt's options (Settings -> Devices & services -> PwMngt -> Configure). This warning clears itself once the sensor works again.

field_utility_meter.title: PwMngt: "{field}" points at a Utility Meter
field_utility_meter.description:
PwMngt's field **{field}** points at `{entity_id}`, a Utility Meter helper. This field must be a raw counter that never resets: PwMngt reads it just after the top of the hour, takes the meter's reset for a new counter and books the hour as about 0 kWh.

Pick the underlying total counter instead in PwMngt's options (Settings -> Devices & services -> PwMngt -> Configure). This warning clears itself once the field is changed.

stromligning_entity_required.title: PwMngt needs a Strømligning sensor that is disabled
stromligning_entity_required.description:
PwMngt reads Strømligning's **{key}** entity, but it is disabled (Strømligning disables its prices without VAT by default) or missing. Without it, the sale price, tomorrow's sale plan and the sell decision don't work.

Go to Settings -> Devices & services -> Strømligning -> entities, enable the entity, and reload Strømligning. This warning clears itself once the entity is enabled.

stromligning_entity_recommended.title: PwMngt: Strømligning's sale price is not enabled
stromligning_entity_recommended.description:
Strømligning's **{key}** entity (the sale price for surplus production) is disabled or missing. PwMngt then prices sales at the spot price without VAT, without the production tariff deducted -- about 2 øre/kWh too high.

To use it: Settings -> Devices & services -> Strømligning -> Configure -> enable "Include sale prices for surplus production", enable the entity and reload Strømligning. Don't sell? Then you can ignore this warning.

no_fuse_phases.title: PwMngt: no main fuse phase sensors selected
no_fuse_phases.description:
None of the fields **Main fuse load L1**, **L2** and **L3** on the Solar PV Plant page has a sensor. The battery's grid charge then doesn't take the main fuse into account: it always charges at "Charge 75", also while e.g. a car is charging.

To fix: Settings -> Devices & services -> PwMngt -> Configure -> Solar PV Plant -> pick the phase-current sensors (A). No phase-current meter? Then you can ignore this warning.

consumption_counts_battery.title: PwMngt: the consumption sensor seems to count the battery's charging
consumption_counts_battery.description:
PwMngt's field **Total property consumption** points at `{entity_id}`. On nights the battery charges from the grid, that sensor rises by about the charged energy -- it looks like it counts the battery's charging as consumption (for example a meter that is purchase + PV - sale).

Then a night with a grid charge looks like a night with high consumption: the nightly target rises, the next night charges more, and so on.

Pick a sensor with the house's own consumption in PwMngt's options (Settings -> Devices & services -> PwMngt -> Configure -> Solar PV Plant). This warning clears itself once the pattern is gone (checked every night at 00:15).

inverter_control_off.title: PwMngt: Inverter control is off
inverter_control_off.description:
The inverter's fields for PwMngt's own control are filled in, but the switch **Inverter control** on the device PwM PV is off. PwMngt then writes nothing to the inverter: no min SoC, no relays, no usage mode.

To fix: Settings -> Devices & services -> PwMngt -> PwM PV -> turn on **Inverter control**. Not ready for PwMngt to control the inverter yet? Then you can ignore this warning.

adjust_savings.name: Adjust savings total
adjust_savings.description: Adds an amount to (or, if negative, subtracts it from) one of the running totals behind the savings sensors -- to correct what a wrongly mapped counter booked. The headline savings sensors only follow upwards. The period totals (today / this month / this year) can be moved directly, e.g. to start "this year" from an existing utility meter.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: DKK to add; negative to subtract.

set_night_charge_target.name: Set night charge target
set_night_charge_target.description: Charges the battery from the grid to this SoC (up to 100 %) tonight instead of the automation's own target -- for this one night only. PwMngt does not re-plan the night while it stands, and no battery sale is planned. At or below the minimum SoC: no grid charge tonight.

target.name: Target
target.description: The SoC (%) to charge to tonight; 0 = no grid charge.

reset_night_charge_target.name: Reset night charge target
reset_night_charge_target.description: Goes back to the automation's own night charge plan.

charge_now.name: Charge battery now
charge_now.description: Charges the battery from the grid now at a share of Battery max charge effect, until the SoC reaches the target (or the charge is stopped). Takes over from the automation while it runs; the main fuse check still applies.

power.name: Power
power.description: Share (%) of Battery max charge effect.

target_soc.name: Target SoC
target_soc.description: The SoC (%) the charge stops at.

no_night_plan.message: There is no night charge plan to change right now -- tonight's plan is made when tomorrow's prices are out.
